Morgan (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — opening this thread to capture the concrete asks and owners about customer wins/losses. Keep entries short so we can triage.
Priya (CS): CS summary: most frequent blockers = proof of data residency, lengthy legal timelines, and surprise billing on burst traffic. Request: a single downloadable "Customer Readiness" pack.
Diego (Product): From product: folks asked for three things: 1) POC runbook with success criteria, 2) a clear Dedicated vs Private comparison (ops + cost), 3) connector quickstarts for top customer stacks. Which should we prioritize?
Morgan (CEO): Prioritize compliance/residency artifacts first (customers literally can't proceed without these). Second: POC runbook + AE collection checklist. Third: connectors.
Raya (Sales): Field examples: BankCo (lost) required strict residency + audit logs; Retailly (won but shaky) had weekend latency spikes; AppBuilder (lost) needed a native CMS connector. I'll upload anonymized notes.
Lina (Solutions): Two wins where Solutions ran a 7-day POC: small dedicated pool + prefix caching cut both latency and cost. We should capture that as a templated playbook.
Jonas (Eng): Engineering quick wins: enable prefix KV caching for POCs by default, shorten default batching window for low-latency POC clusters, and publish recommended kernel profiles per GPU. I can draft configs and microbenchmarks.
Aisha (Security): I'll draft a compliance pack: cert list, sample network diagram, KMS/TLS snippets, and a short contract blurb customers can hand to legal. ETA: 8 business days.
Diego (Product): Action: I'll own the POC runbook + Dedicated vs Private one-pager. ETA: 6 business days. Will include an AE collection checklist.
Priya (CS): Action: I'll assemble anonymized loss notes and win patterns, plus a prioritized connector wishlist. Owner: Priya + Raya. ETA: 10 business days.
Raya (Sales): I'll post sanitized loss notes to #sales-docs and link here when done. Also flag priority accounts for follow-up.
Jonas (Eng): Small snippet I'll include in the latency playbook: sample CLI to reproduce estimator:
```
./estimate-cost --qps 80 --avg_tokens 110 --model r-1-reply
```
estimates tokens/hr and cost.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-4799: "all-hands: customer readiness pack & POC runbook" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4799)
Morgan (CEO): Please add owners + due dates to the issue and tag @eng for connector quickstarts. Quick ask: if anyone has <2h snippets (network diagram, Terraform, one-pager) drop them into the issue now so AEs can use them.
Priya (CS): Scheduling a 30-min review next Wed 9am PT to review first drafts. Invite to @here.
Diego (Product): Will post first-pass runbook to the issue 48h before the sync.
Lina (Solutions): I'll prepare the POC checklist for capacity, cache config, and success metrics and include a short sample playbook paragraph teams can copy.
Raya (Sales): Thanks everyone  I'll start customer outreach after artifacts land and report back on lift.
Morgan (CEO): Great. Let's aim to close these loops before the next roadmap review. :rocket:
